documents.title: Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.
Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - ESG Ratings.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Gujarat Narmada Valley Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited reported significantly higher Q1 FY27 profits driven by better realizations despite lower sales volumes and war-induced input cost pressures. Management highlighted the resumption of operations in July for several previously shut chemical plants (including acetic acid, ethyl acetate, and TDI) and positive revisions to urea energy norms. The company also provided updates on ongoing projects like the Dahej steam and power plant and outlined capex plans and cost-saving initiatives. Management stated that Q1 FY 26-27 revenue marginally increased sequentially due to improved realizations across products, though partly offset by lower volumes. Profit before tax decreased quarter-on-quarter due to higher input and fixed costs alongside lower volumes, while year-on-year comparisons are affected by the prior year's annual turnaround in the Bharuch complex.

guidance.claim: Management expects TGU production to be more or less at the same level as that of the last financial year.
guidance.quote: See, basically it is our expectation of the TGU production to more less at the same level as that of last FY.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that there is a shortage in the Indian market of TDI that will definitely affect pricing.
demand_outlook.quote: Yes, there is a shortage in the Indian market of TDI that will definitely affect the pricing.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that overall globally TDI production is quite high against demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall globally TDI production is quite high against the demand.

demand_outlook.claim: The company reported lower volumes in the majority of products during Q1.
demand_outlook.quote: During Q-o-Q Q 1, Revenue marginally increased mainly due to improved realisation across all of the products, which is partially offset by lower volume in majority of products.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the CAGR for ammonium nitrate is around 6% to 7%.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as the ammonium nitrate is concerned, CAGR is around 6% to 7%.

demand_outlook.claim: Tejash Shah noted that international trends for both acetic acid and ethyl acetate are in a reducing trend.
demand_outlook.quote: Presently, as far as the international trend is concerned, the acetic acid as well as ethyl acetate trends are in reducing trend, both the prices.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex incurred in Q1 was INR300 crores in CWIP.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex incurred was INR300 crores in CWIP.

capex_expansion.claim: Targeted capex for the full year is another INR1,200 crores to INR1,500 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Targeted for the full year is another INR1,200 crores to INR1,500 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The total projects on hand are of INR2,800 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The total projects on hand are of INR2,800 crores, okay?

capex_expansion.claim: Ammonia Expansion at Bharuch has a capacity of 50 KTPA.
Weak Nitric Acid –III at Bharuch has a capacity of 200 KTPA.
Ammonium Nitrate –II at Bharuch has a capacity of 163 KTPA.
New CFBC Steam Boiler at Bharuch has a capacity of 180 ~ 200 MT/HR.
capex_expansion.quote: 5. New CFBC Steam Boiler – Bharuch 180 ~ 200 MT/HR

capex_expansion.claim: Projects under consideration include BisPhenol-A (BPA) at Dahej, Polyols at Dahej, and Acetic Acid at Bharuch.
capex_expansion.quote:
1. BisPhenol-A (BPA) – Dahej 150 KTPA
2. Polyols – Dahej 100 KTPA
3. Acetic Acid - Bharuch 350 KTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that ammonium nitrate, weak nitric acid, and ammonia expansion projects are on track with a minor delay of around 2.5 months in weak nitric acid.
capex_expansion.quote: See, both these 3 projects actually, ammonium nitrate, weak nitric acid and ammonia expansion are going on track. There is a slight minor delay in case of weak nitric acid of around 2.5 months.

capex_expansion.claim: D.V. Parikh stated that the total capex for FY27 is going to be around INR 2,800 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex for FY27 is going to be around INR 2,800 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: D.V. Parikh stated that the dialogue is on with INEOS regarding licensing for additional capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: Now we are talking to them about licensing for additional capacity. So that dialogue is on with INEOS.

margins_costs.claim: Energy norms for urea have been revised upward from 6.20 Gcal per metric ton to 6.37 Gcal.
margins_costs.quote: It was 6.20 Gcal per metric ton of urea, which is revised to 6.37 Gcal now.

margins_costs.claim: Results decreased mainly due to higher input cost and fixed cost partially offset by better realization.
margins_costs.quote: Result is decreased mainly due to higher input cost and fixed cost partially offset by better realization.

margins_costs.claim: The New Energy Norm of Neem Coated Urea has been fixed at 6.37 Gcal PMT from 1-4-25 to 31-3-28.
margins_costs.quote: The Department of Fertilizers (DoF) has issued Notification dated 30-6-26, according to which the New Energy Norm of Neem Coated Urea ( NCU ) has been fixed at 6.37 Gcal PMT from 1-4-25 to 31-3-28 as against the earlier norm of 6.20 Gcal PMT.

margins_costs.claim: There will be a positive financial impact of approximately 61 crores for Apr-25 to Jun-26 from the NCU energy norm revision.
margins_costs.quote: As per preliminary assessment, there will be positive financial impact of approximately ₹ 61 crores for Apr-25 to Jun-26 which will be accounted for in Q-2-FY-26-27 after detailed examination.

margins_costs.claim: The revision in fixed cost for NCU is being pursued with the Government at industry level.
margins_costs.quote: The revision in fixed cost for NCU is being pursued with the Government at industry level.

margins_costs.claim: The Coal Based Steam & Power Plant is expected to improve operating margins of TDI II.
margins_costs.quote: • Coal Based Steam & Power Plant: Expected to improve the operating margins of TDI II.

margins_costs.claim: D.V. Parikh stated that full year PAT improved by 35% to INR797 crores, with INR 1,065 crores of PBT.
margins_costs.quote: whereas PAT has improved on a full year basis by 35% to INR797 crores, with INR 1,065 crores of PBT.

margins_costs.claim: D.V. Parikh noted that there are one-timers of around INR30 crores in Q4 and around INR80 crores on a full year basis.
margins_costs.quote: In terms of whether there are any one-timers of note, there are one-timers of around INR30 crores in Q4 and around INR80 crores on a full year basis.

margins_costs.claim: Tejash Shah stated that price hikes in chemicals ranged from 6% to 28%.
margins_costs.quote: Product to product, but if you see the range, it is from 6% to 28%.

margins_costs.claim: D.V. Parikh stated that on a quarter-on-quarter basis, there is a 20% improvement in ammonium nitrate prices.
margins_costs.quote: So on a quarter-on-quarter basis, there is a 20% improvement in the ammonium nitrate prices.

orders_capacity.claim: Ammonia production was approximately 173,000 with 54% from oil and 49% from gas.
orders_capacity.quote: Ammonia production was approximately 173,000 and 54% out of that was from oil and 49% was from gas.

orders_capacity.claim: Total TDI production was 12,800 with 66% from Dahej unit and 34% from Bharuch unit.
orders_capacity.quote: So TDI total production was 12,800 a breakup of 66% from Dahej unit and 34% from Bharuch unit.

orders_capacity.claim: WNA total production was 113,000 with a split of 70% and 30% across two plants.
orders_capacity.quote: WNA total is 113,000 production with a share of 2 plant, 70% and 30%.

orders_capacity.claim: TGU production was 74,800 and formic acid production was 8,200.
orders_capacity.quote: TGU was 74,800 and formic acid was 8,200.

orders_capacity.claim: Nitin Patel stated that ammonia oil route production was close to 3 lakh metric ton, gas route was 360,000, CNA was 147,000, WNA was 430,000, and TDI was around 57,000.
orders_capacity.quote: Ammonia oil route was close to 3 lakh metric ton. Gas route was 360,000. I am Nitin Patel, Executive Director. CNA was 147,000, and WNA, 430,000 approximately and TDI around 57,000.

orders_capacity.claim: Nitin Patel stated that formic acid production was close to 34,000 and AN Melt was close to 170,000.
orders_capacity.quote: Formic acid was close to 34,000, and AN Melt was close to 170,000.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that capacity utilization in the acetic acid and most other plants is above 100%, while TDI is close to 80%.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization in case of acetic and most of the plants is above 100%. So far as TDI is concerned, it is close to 80%.

capital_allocation.claim: D.V. Parikh stated that the Board declared a dividend of 210%, amounting to INR21 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Considering all this, Board has in general declared a dividend of 210%. This is INR21 per share, which is historically the second highest dividend in its history of 50 years.

risks_headwinds.claim: Certain plants like acetic acid, ethyl acetate, and TDI could not be run during the quarter for cost economics reasons.
risks_headwinds.quote: During this quarter gone by, there are plants which we could not run for cost economics reason, like acetic acid, ethyl acetate and to some extent, TDI as well.

risks_headwinds.claim: Gas prices are significantly higher and gas availability and price volatility remain a concern.
risks_headwinds.quote: Similarly, on front of the gas, the prices remains volatile and availability of the volume is always a concern, but our operations are not affected with -- on account of availability of the gas.

risks_headwinds.claim: There is a slight time change of about 3 months delay in case of the weak nitric acid plant, which is being actively monitored and going to be recouped.
risks_headwinds.quote: There is a slight time change in case of a weak nitric acid plant, but that is being monitored actively. So about 3 months delay is there, which is going to be recouped.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company continues to closely monitor geopolitical developments and proactively take necessary actions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Company continues to closely monitor geopolitical developments and are proactively taking necessary actions to safeguard interest of all Stakeholders.

risks_headwinds.claim: The continuing war has changed the equation of value addition with adverse divergence between feed cost and final output realisation in some cases.
risks_headwinds.quote: The continuing war has change the equation of value addition as in some cases, there is adverse divergence between feed cost and final output realisation.

risks_headwinds.claim: D.V. Parikh noted that due to the war in late February and early March, volume of TDI and neem urea was slightly impacted.
risks_headwinds.quote: Due to the war in the early -- late February and early March, it has impacted slightly the volume of TDI as well as neem urea.

risks_headwinds.claim: Nitin Patel noted that revision in urea fixed cost and energy norms are overdue, causing widening losses in the Fertilizer segment.
risks_headwinds.quote: In case of fertilizer, the revision both in urea of fixed cost as well as energy norms are yet to happen. And this is overdue as the losses are widening in case of Fertilizer segment.

management_commitments.claim: The energy norms revision for urea is valid for a period of 3 years starting from FY25-26.
management_commitments.quote: This has been revised for a period from FY25-26, and valid for 3 years period.

management_commitments.claim: Power from the Dahej steam and power project is expected to come in around 45 days' time.
management_commitments.quote: And power, we are expecting to come in a month's time or so or around 45 days' time.

management_commitments.claim: Except for the CCPP, the rest of the projects under execution are going to be commercially operational sometime in the mid of 2027.
management_commitments.quote: The rest are going to be commercially operational sometime in the mid of 2027.

management_commitments.claim: The positive financial impact of approximately 61 crores for Apr-25 to Jun-26 will be accounted for in Q-2-FY-26-27 after detailed examination.
management_commitments.quote: As per preliminary assessment, there will be positive financial impact of approximately ₹ 61 crores for Apr-25 to Jun-26 which will be accounted for in Q-2-FY-26-27 after detailed examination.

management_commitments.claim: D.V. Parikh stated that the coal-based CCPP synchronization is revised for sometime in the third week of June.
management_commitments.quote: and they have revised the date now for synchronization sometime in the third week of June.

management_commitments.claim: D.V. Parikh stated that the performance guarantee test run for the coal-based CCPP is scheduled for sometime in the third week of August 2026.
management_commitments.quote: And for the performance guarantee test run to make it available on a full steam basis, it is sometime in the third week of August '26.

management_commitments.claim: Nitin Patel stated that a planned shutdown is scheduled in April 2027.
management_commitments.quote: We have a planned shutdown in April '27.

management_commitments.claim: D.V. Parikh stated that new projects identification will have clarity by the end of this calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: The new projects identification will have clarity by end of this calendar year for taking it to the investment table-grade decisions.

management_commitments.claim: D.V. Parikh stated that all three projects—ammonia expansion, weak nitric acid, and ammonium nitrate melt—are going to come up by next year.
management_commitments.quote: All the three-ammonia expansion, the nitric acid, ammonium nitrate melt, all are going to come up by next year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
